title: The Drowned Ember
premise: Paloma Halloran, youngest keeper of the Ember Guild's ledgers, discovers that the guild's 'impossible things' were once payment in an ancient covenant between the human city of Vaelmoor and the drowned realm beneath its harbor. When a child arrives speaking the pre-kingdom tongue, Paloma learns the covenant was broken by her own guild generations ago, and the drowned realm is rising to collect. To save both worlds she must reforge the covenant herself — not as a scribe recording old debts, but as a signatory with power of her own. In the end she binds the realms together at the cost of her guild name and her place in it, becoming something new: neither keeper nor outsider, but the living ledger between them.
about_author: Vesper Lockridge is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing maritime trade records before turning to fiction. They write about ledgers, tides, and the people history forgets to count.

chapters.title: The Weight of Small Debts
chapters.summary: Paloma audits the guild's crumbling ledgers, chafing under the senior keepers' dismissal of her as a child with neat handwriting. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: restless ambition shadowed by belonging — she loves the guild that barely sees her.

chapters.title: A Knock Before Dawn
chapters.summary: A mud-soaked child appears at the guild door speaking a language no keeper recognizes — except the oldest ledger, whose marginalia matches it exactly. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into dread as the impossible becomes inventory.

chapters.title: What the Ledgers Omit
chapters.summary: Paloma finds pages razored from the founding covenant; Senior Keeper Aldous Vane warns her to stop asking. The child, Nen, draws the drowned realm from memory. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: first taste of institutional betrayal.

chapters.title: The Thirteenth Moon Rises
chapters.summary: Harbor tides begin running backward on moonless nights. A guild courier drowns in dry air. POV: alternating Paloma and Vane. Emotional beat: denial breaking — the debt is real, and it is coming due.

chapters.title: Salt in the Ink
chapters.summary: Paloma deciphers that the guild once traded memories, names, and years across the covenant — until they kept the goods and severed the bargain. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: shame inherited, guilt not yet earned but fully felt.

chapters.title: The Drowned Envoy
chapters.summary: A figure of brine and lantern-light walks out of the harbor demanding the covenant be honored or the city drowned. The guild offers Paloma up as a scapegoat clerk. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: abandonment by the only home she had.

chapters.title: Running the Undertow
chapters.summary: Paloma flees with Nen through Vaelmoor's flooded lower quarters, learning the child is the drowned realm's last-born heir sent as living collateral. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: fierce protectiveness — a found family of two.

chapters.title: Thieves of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Paloma seeks the guild's exiled founder, Ilsa Maren, now a smuggler trading in covenant-goods. Ilsa confirms the theft but refuses help without payment. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: bitter lesson — justice has a price outside the law.

chapters.title: Payment in Names
chapters.summary: To afford Ilsa's aid, Paloma trades away her own guild-name, erasing her membership from every record. She feels it leave like a tooth pulled. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: grief for identity freely surrendered.

chapters.title: The Sunken Archive
chapters.summary: Ilsa leads them into the drowned quarter where the original covenant sleeps in a pressurized vault of old magic. Vane's hunters close in. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: awe and claustrophobia in equal measure.

chapters.title: Vane's Confession
chapters.summary: Cornered, Vane admits the senior keepers have been feeding the drowned realm small payments for years — including children — to delay this day. POV: Vane. Emotional beat: horror wearing the mask of duty.

chapters.title: Nen Speaks
chapters.summary: Nen finally speaks common tongue: the drowned realm doesn't want vengeance, it wants to be remembered — the covenant was a marriage, not a contract. POV: Nen. Emotional beat: heartbreak reframing everything.

chapters.title: The Broken Seal
chapters.summary: They open the vault; the covenant crumbles to salt at human touch. Only a willing signatory from each realm can reforge it, and the moon turns for the last time in three days. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: despair sharpened into resolve.

chapters.title: The Guild Turns Its Face
chapters.summary: Paloma returns to beg the guild to stand as signatory; Vane's rivals vote instead to sacrifice Nen on the thirteenth moon. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: cold clarity — the law will not deliver justice.

chapters.title: Stealing a Child Back
chapters.summary: Paloma and Ilsa raid the guildhall to free Nen from the ritual chamber, fighting former colleagues. Ilsa takes a mortal wound covering their escape. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: loyalty proven in blood.

chapters.title: Ilsa's Last Ledger
chapters.summary: Dying, Ilsa signs the human half of the covenant in her own blood and passes the pen to Paloma: 'Debts need a debtor. Make yourself worth owing.' POV: Ilsa. Emotional beat: inheritance of purpose.

chapters.title: The Descent
chapters.summary: Paloma carries Nen down through the drowning streets into the harbor's throat as the final moonrise begins, pursued by the flood itself. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: terror transmuted into determination.

chapters.title: Court of Lanterns
chapters.summary: In the drowned realm's court, Paloma argues the guild's guilt honestly — offering truth instead of excuses. The drowned elders are moved but bound by the old terms. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: justice spoken aloud at last.

chapters.title: The Thirteenth Turn
chapters.summary: As the moon completes its turn, Paloma signs the reforged covenant in her own name — nameless, therefore unbound by any guild — binding herself as the living ledger between realms. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: self-sacrifice become self-definition.

chapters.title: Two Tides, One Harbor
chapters.summary: The flood recedes; the realms settle into balance. Nen chooses to stay with Paloma rather than return below. POV: Nen. Emotional beat: belonging chosen, not assigned.

chapters.title: The Guild Without a Name
chapters.summary: Paloma returns to the guildhall, which must register her as neither member nor stranger — a new category written into law by necessity. Vane resigns in disgrace. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: quiet vindication.

chapters.title: First Entry
chapters.summary: Paloma opens a fresh ledger and writes the covenant's first new entry in both tongues, Nen beside her. Somewhere below, lanterns answer. POV: Paloma. Emotional beat: peace — identity forged, justice kept, home remade.
